results.title: [Research Ready] Level Up Your Internet Search
results.description:
Search smarter in the age of AI! In this hands-on workshop, we will unlock the power of Google search operators for precise, targeted results, deepen information discovery with Google AI Mode to surface nuanced, contextual evidence, and time-travel with the Wayback Machine to uncover hidden web gems.

(Complete any 3 workshops in the Research Ready Series to earn a digital badge for your LinkedIn profile!)

Note: You are welcome to walk in even if you've missed the registration window of this workshop. Please bring along your laptop or tablet with Internet access.

What did our previous participants say about this workshop?

  • "I learnt how to search for papers more efficiently."
  • "Web search gets better the more you think about what kinds of sources might give you the information you want, and where to find them."
  • "I enjoyed learning about new tools, such as the site and file type limiters."
  • "I'm able to learn useful features for my future Google search. The Wayback Machine can help me to bypass certain restrictions due to aging resources."
  • "It was very digestible for a beginner! I learnt a lot of new information."
